column2: the plan tells implementers to merge duplicate step 5c `_publish_rc` prose in `skills/design/references/finalize-step5.md` (§76-98), but `scripts/test-design-structure.sh:542-544` requires byte-exact `contains` needles (`when `_publish_rc=2` or an unexpected...`, `this includes `_publish_rc=5`.`, `when `_publish_rc=3`, the publish tail...`) that exist in the compose block (lines 94-96/98), not in the earlier abort-contract block (lines 76-83). the abbreviated §76-80 block uses different typography and wording (`_publish_rc`=n vs backtick forms). consolidating, normalizing, or paraphrasing duplicates can drop the only pinned copies and fail `test-design-structure.sh` even when behavior still looks equivalent.

edge cases and the testing strategy cite only `scripts/test-design-structure.sh`, but `scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh:126` and `:130` also `grep -fq` finalize-step5 abort-path strings (`parse final_summary_path... read-always readiness profile`, `complete the shared sidecar follow-on before stopping.`). those lines sit in the same step 5c publish section targeted for compression. the focused test list does not run that harness, so a prose pass can pass listed checks yet fail `make test-harnesses-2` and `/implement` relevant checks (`python/larch/implement/checks_run_relevant.py` runs both harnesses for `skills/design/references/*.md` changes).
